bias.en: Pullback · under the 5, 10 and 30-day, SAR at $511
bias.zh: 回调 · 低于 5、10 和 30 日均线，抛物线 SAR 在 $511

read.en: Microsoft rose 0.4% on Nov 12 to $523.00, trading $520.02–529.61 on light volume (0.68x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($530.6), 10-day ($529.5) and 30-day ($530.3) and above the 100-day ($478.5) and 200-day ($441.0); all five are rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 10, above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($511.15), and RSI is 48.4.
read.zh: 微软 11月12日上涨 0.4%，收于 $523.00，盘中区间 $520.02–529.61，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.68 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$530.6）、10 日（$529.5）和 30 日均线（$530.3）下方，100 日（$478.5）和 200 日均线（$441.0）上方；五条均线均在上行。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$511.15），RSI 为 48.4。

read.en: No level changed: the $529.61 high stalled under the 10-day and the $518.45 Nov 11 low held. Resistance is $524.5–530.6 (Nov 6 and 10 lows, three averages), then $533.2–534.8 and $541.3–544.2. Support is $518.5–521, then $505–511.2 (Nov 2 and 3 lows, SAR) and $486 (Sep 10 low). A close above $530.6 would target $534–544; below $511.2, the SAR flips and $486 opens.
